vocabulary.note_ar: pretty كصفة تعني جميل، لكن قبل صفة أخرى تعني إلى حد ما
vocabulary.note_en: As an adjective it means beautiful; before another adjective it means "quite".

vocabulary.meaning_en: help (in "give me a hand"); also the body part
vocabulary.example: Can you give me a hand with these bags?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to care about or be bothered by something
words you say when someone has success
vocabulary.note_ar: تُقال دائمًا بحرف s في آخرها

vocabulary.meaning_en: to ask for food or goods
vocabulary.example: I'd like to order a large pizza.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea or a piece of information
vocabulary.example: I have no clue where my keys are.

vocabulary.meaning_en: having enough value to be good to do
the main idea someone wants to say

fine_lines.title: Never mind vs I don't mind
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Never mind تعني: انسَ الأمر، لا يهم. أما I don't mind فتعني: لا مانع لدي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Never mind" means forget it, it's not important. "I don't mind" means it's okay with me.

examples.sentence: Sorry, what did you say? - Never mind, it's not important.
Tea or coffee? - I don't mind.

fine_lines.title: I don't care vs It's up to you
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I don't care قد تبدو قاسية وتعني: لا يهمني. أما It's up to you فهي مهذبة وتعني: القرار لك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I don't care" can sound rude. "It's up to you" is polite: you decide.

examples.sentence: I don't care what they say about my shoes.
Pizza or rice? - It's up to you.

fine_lines.title: What do you mean? vs Come again?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: What do you mean? تطلب شرح المعنى. Come again? تطلب إعادة الكلام لأنك لم تسمعه جيدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "What do you mean?" asks for the meaning. "Come again?" asks the person to repeat because you didn't hear.

examples.sentence: What do you mean by 'soon'? Today or tomorrow?
Come again? It's very noisy here.

expressions.meaning_en: An informal greeting: How are you? What's new?
expressions.example: Hey Ali, what's up?

expressions.meaning_en: A common answer to "How are you?"
expressions.example: How are you? - Pretty good, thanks.
Could you give me a hand with this table?
Never mind, I found my phone.
What do you mean? I don't understand.
Let's have lunch at the park. - That sounds great!
Thanks for waiting for me. I appreciate it.
Thanks for your help! - Anytime.

expressions.meaning_en: Said when someone succeeds or has good news.
expressions.example: You passed the test? Congratulations!

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to order food or things.
expressions.example: I'd like to order a medium pizza, please.
Where is the manager? - I have no clue.
Chill out, we'll finish on time.

expressions.meaning_en: It does not matter to me (can sound rude).
expressions.example: I don't care about the color; I just need a bag.
Where should we eat? - It's up to you.
You have news? Tell me, I'm all ears.

expressions.meaning_en: The effort or cost is too much for the result.
expressions.example: Don't argue with him. It's not worth it.
Hang on a second, I'll get my keys.
Hang on a sec, someone is at the door.
You won the prize? You're kidding me!
Don't start without me. I'm on my way.
Should we start the new project? - Absolutely!

expressions.meaning_en: Please repeat; I didn't hear you (informal).
expressions.example: Come again? I didn't catch your name.
Is he at work now? - I'm not sure about that.

expressions.meaning_en: Goodbye, we will speak again soon.
expressions.example: I have to go now. Talk to you later!

expressions.meaning_en: A formal way to ask people to sit down.
expressions.example: Welcome, everyone. Please be seated.

expressions.meaning_en: Did you understand my main idea?
expressions.example: We need more time, not more people. Did you get my point?

grammar.title: I'd like to + verb / I'd like + noun
grammar.explanation_ar: I'd like اختصار I would like وتعني أود. هي أكثر أدبًا من I want. بعدها إما to + فعل (I'd like to order) أو اسم مباشرة (I'd like a pizza).
grammar.explanation_en: "I'd like" = "I would like". It is more polite than "I want". Use "to + verb" or a noun after it.
examples: I'd like to order a large pizza.
I'd like a glass of water, please.
I would like to order delivery.

grammar.title: Questions with do: What do you mean?
grammar.explanation_ar: في المضارع البسيط نضع do قبل الفاعل لنصنع سؤالًا: What + do + you + الفعل الأصلي؟ ومع he/she نستخدم does.
grammar.explanation_en: In the present simple, put "do" before the subject to make a question: What + do + you + base verb? Use "does" with he/she/it.

grammar.title: Present continuous for now: I'm on my way / You're kidding
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + فعل ينتهي بـ ing لشيء يحدث الآن. You're kidding = أنت تمزح الآن.
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for something happening now.

questions.question: Your friend thanks you. A friendly reply is:
questions.explanation_ar: Anytime رد ودود على الشكر بمعنى في أي وقت.
questions.explanation_en: "Anytime" is a friendly reply to thanks.

questions.question: "I have no clue" means:
questions.explanation_ar: I have no clue = ليست لدي أي فكرة.
questions.explanation_en: It means I really don't know.

questions.question: Your friend asks: "Tea or juice?" A polite answer that lets them choose is:
questions.explanation_ar: It's up to you مهذبة وتعني القرار لك، أما I don't care فقد تبدو قاسية.
questions.explanation_en: "It's up to you" is polite; "I don't care" can sound rude.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I'd like to ordering a pizza.
I'd likes to order a pizza.
I'd like to order a pizza.
questions.explanation_ar: الصيغة الصحيحة: I'd like to + الفعل الأصلي.
questions.explanation_en: The pattern is "I'd like to + base verb".

questions.question: You didn't hear what someone said because of noise. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: Come again? تطلب من الشخص إعادة ما قاله.

questions.question: "I'm all ears" means:
questions.explanation_ar: I'm all ears = كلي آذان صاغية، أي أستمع بانتباه.

questions.question: Your friend calls: "Where are you?" You are coming now. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: I'm on my way = أنا في الطريق.
questions.explanation_en: "I'm on my way" means I'm coming now.

questions.question: "Sorry, what did you say?" - "___, it's not important."
questions.explanation_ar: Never mind = انسَ الأمر، لا يهم.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال الصحيح: What do you mean? مع do والفعل الأصلي.
questions.explanation_en: Use "do" + you + base verb: What do you mean?

questions.question: Which phrase asks someone for help carrying something?
questions.explanation_en: "Give me a hand" means help me.
